bureau: Central Registry of Credits (Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina)
note: The Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's own page on its Central Registry of Credits of legal entities and natural persons (read 2026-10-30; the Decision on the Central Register of Credits it links was last amended with effect from 1 July 2024) gives a natural person's report on current liabilities and one on settled liabilities, and says the data on settled liabilities are kept for the previous five years, counting from the date of actual repayment. The game reads this as a late payment shown while the liability is unpaid (keep 30, 'the longest the game keeps') and lifting five years after it is repaid (clears 1826). No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported, so the days are the game's reading: the registry's next monthly update.
